title: Tension project configuration
description: The one project file that belongs to Tension. Every key here is read by the `tension` CLI and by nothing else; the runtime takes a .wasm and no app configuration. A key no code reads is a lie with a schema, so the set is closed: unknown keys are refused rather than ignored.

$schema.description: Editor hint. Not read by the CLI.

entry.description: The guest's entry file, relative to the project root. Passed to `tensionscript`.

renderer.description: Which renderer the project uses. `2d` is built into the host, so it needs no adapter and no environment. `ogre` loads `libtension_ogre.so` and needs the Ogre-Next libraries, plugins and Hlms media.

window.description: The window the guest asks the host for. The runtime has no window flag: the CLI turns these three values into `--window=WxH`, `--title=...` and (for a headless run) `--headless`, and the guest reads them with `windowRequest()`.

width.description: Logical width in pixels. The 2D canvas is opened at exactly this size.

title.description: The window title. Defaults to the project's package.json `name`.

memory.description: The guest's wasm memory. Only the initial page count is a project decision: the arena geometry (memoryBase = max_arena_size) is the framework's, and a guest compiled against a different geometry is refused at session open.

initialPages.description: Initial memory in 64 KiB pages. Must be at least the framework's own initial_pages and at most its maximum_pages; see `tension doctor` for both numbers. 200 is the default because a guest that holds a 1280x720 frame (3.5 MB) does not fit in the framework's 133.

assets.description: A directory packed into one .tns volume and mounted read-only as `/`. Omit this key entirely and no volume is built — a project with no assets is a project with no volume, not an empty one.

dir.description: The tree to pack, relative to the project root.

volume.description: Where the packed volume is written, relative to the project root.

capabilities.description: Capability adapters to load besides the renderer. Each entry is resolved as a platform payload package and passed to the host as `--capability`.
